record: Reserved move pool, catalogued 2026-09-12. Design intent only; nothing implemented.
purpose: The owner may build a deliberately difficult late-game path that grants some of these moves as a reward for deep play. Expected to be designed alongside the deferred breeding and inheritance rules.
method: Resolved species_enabled.h and walked the species_info #if guards to get the 787 compiled-in species, then subtracted every move reachable by any of them through ORAS level-up learnsets, teachable learnsets (vanilla Emerald's 58 TM/HM moves plus 30 Emerald tutors) and egg moves. Z-Moves and Max Moves are excluded by move id. Volt Tackle is excluded because it IS reachable, through the Light Ball breeding rule.
important_distinction: The tm_gap list is NOT reward material. Those are moves a roster species legitimately learns in the source games and cannot reach only because the TM/HM and tutor lists are still vanilla Emerald's. They should be fixed by the open TM/HM decision, not gated behind a reward. Blast Burn, Hydro Cannon, Frenzy Plant, Draco Meteor and Focus Blast are all in this category.

engine_precedent.current_contents: A single row: Pichu + Light Ball -> Volt Tackle.
engine_precedent.note: This is the exact hook the owner's idea extends: offspring species, a required held item, and the granted move. Adding rows is trivial; the design work is what the gate should be.

tier_1_high_risk.note: The moves screened during the egg-move review. These are the ones that would actually warp battles, which is why they are worth gating rather than simply distributing.

moves.LAST_RESPECTS: 50 base, but power grows with every fainted party member. The only genuinely game-warping move already present in egg_moves.h; sits behind #if P_HISUIAN_FORMS on Basculin White-Striped, which is compiled out.
moves.POPULATION_BOMB: 20 base, strikeCount 10. Up to 200 power before items, and Wide Lens pushes its accuracy problem aside.
moves.SURGING_STRIKES: 25 base, strikeCount 3, alwaysCriticalHit TRUE. Ignores defensive boosts.
moves.WICKED_BLOW: 80 base here (75 from Gen 9 data), alwaysCriticalHit TRUE.
moves.FISHIOUS_REND: 85 base here, doubles to 170 when the user moves first.
moves.BOLT_BEAK: 85 base here, doubles to 170 when the user moves first.
moves.GLAIVE_RUSH: 120 base Dragon physical, with a drawback turn.
moves.SALT_CURE: 40 base, but applies chip damage that is far worse for Steel and Water targets.

tier_2_vault_highlights.note: Strongest entries from the 172 moves no compiled-in species can ever learn. Most are signature moves of Gen 6-9 species that are not on this roster.

limits: A reachability snapshot against the current configuration. Changing the TM/HM list, the tutor set, learnsets or the roster profile changes both lists; regenerate rather than trusting this file.
No balance testing was performed. Power and effect are read from moves_info.h.
Nothing here is approved canon or an implementation commitment.
revised_2026_09_12: M04 expanded the TM list from 50 to 100 and restored exactly one move from this list: Focus Blast. The remainder are predominantly tutor moves or Gen 6-9 TM moves, so the bucket is better read as a TUTOR gap than a TM gap.
STALE: Superseded 2026-09-12. These counts describe the discarded first M04 build. The curated per-region TM list removed Focus Blast again, so nothing from the tm_gap list is restored. Regenerate before use. The 'gating a starter ultimate would be a mistake' note also predates the owner-approved late signature-tutor economy.
